chunks: And from him, from Abu Abdillah al-Husayn ibn Ali al-Bazawfari, who said: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik narrated to us, who said: Muhammad ibn Yahya narrated to us from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ibn Sinan from Amr ibn Thabit from his father from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:

Allah created Karbala before He created the Kaaba by twenty-four thousand years, and He sanctified it and blessed it, so it remained sanctified and blessed before Allah created the creation, and it will remain thus, and Allah made it the most superior of the earth in Paradise.

key_terms.أَفْضَلَ الْأَرْضِ: The most superior of the earth

ai.seo_question: When was Karbala created relative to the Kaaba and what is its status in Paradise?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights the cosmic preeminence of Karbala by noting its creation 24,000 years prior to the Kaaba, establishing it as a sacred locus blessed before the creation of the heavens and earth. This tradition underscores the theological significance of the site not merely as a historical battlefield, but as an eternal spiritual center within Paradise, reinforcing the Shia practice of visiting (ziyarat) and utilizing its soil for blessings.
